alternatives_and_negative_results: Do not use the 15/15 synthetic qualification as a substitute for spatial transfer, and do not use the later v1.2 CPI-level theorem as retroactive erasure of the historical diagnostic.
applicability: Transfer of statistical or signal-processing methods from synthetic populations to the real radar chain.
assessed_root_cause: The synthetic method qualification and the radar-chain spatial population test different assumptions; shared upstream processing creates structured spatial dependence.
author_role: historical project engineering record, backfilled by FPGA engineering copilot
chosen_corrective_method: Keep method qualification and application-domain transfer as separate evidence claims; preserve the spatial FAIL and any provenance limitations.
generalizable_lesson: A statistical method can be valid under its theorem and still be inapplicable to a particular data-generation or dependence structure.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: Passing synthetic count-model coverage could be treated as proof that the method transfers to the processed radar spatial field.
non_applicability: Does not invalidate the separately approved v1.2 noise-only CPI-level Pfa result within its declared scope.
observable_consequence: The post-alpha spatial diagnostic recorded 4/5 necessary checks passing but failed the anisotropy check at z=43.575 versus |z|<=2.576; the failure and seed-overlap caveat remain recorded.
observed_problem: A calibrated count model passed its synthetic qualification, but a separate real-chain spatial diagnostic failed a prespecified range-versus-Doppler dependence check.
repeatable_validation: Read the spatial failure manifest/report and source-seed overlap addendum; confirm the failed metric and that no retuning or post-hoc data exclusion occurred.
reviewer_role: documentary evidence validation by FPGA engineering copilot; not a separate human reviewer
safety_contract_constraints: Preserve all historical FAIL records; no alpha, denominator, or seed retuning without explicit change control.
title: Method qualification does not establish transfer to the radar-chain spatial population
